claims.quote: Voltage-gated potassium (K+) channel subfamily B member 1 (KCNB1, Kv2.1) and integrin-α5 form macromolecular complexes-named integrin-α5-KCNB1 complexes (IKCs)-in the human brain
membrane depolarization triggered IKC intracellular signals mediated by small GTPases of the Ras subfamily and protein kinase B (Akt)

claims.object_text: advance development of filopodia and lamellipodia; stimulate motility; enhance neurite outgrowth
claims.quote: advance the development of filopodia and lamellipodia in Chinese hamster ovary cells, stimulate their motility, and enhance neurite outgrowth in mouse neuroblastoma Neuro2a cells
Five KCNB1 mutants (L211P, R312H G379R, G381R, and F416L) linked to severe infancy or early-onset epileptic encephalopathy exhibited markedly defective conduction.
R312H and F416L failed to activate Ras/Akt signaling and did not enhance cell migration.

claims.object_text: IKCs modulate cellular plasticity via Ras and Akt signaling
claims.quote: IKCs modulate cellular plasticity via Ras and Akt signaling.
defective IKCs may cause epilepsy through mechanisms other than dysregulated excitability
